title: gwm worktree list
description: Output of `gwm list --format=json` and the daemon's `list` JSON-RPC method (issue #38). A stable array of worktrees, decoupled from gwm's internal types.

repo.description: Owning repo name. Present ONLY in workspace mode (`gwm --workspace <root> list --format=json`); absent for a single-repo listing.

name.description: Display name — basename of the worktree directory.

id.description: Internal git worktree id (.git/worktrees/<id>); may diverge from name after a `git worktree move`.

path.description: Absolute path to the worktree working directory.

branch.description: Checked-out branch shorthand, or null when unresolvable.

head.description: Full HEAD commit oid (40-char hex), or null when unresolvable.

age_seconds.description: Branch age relative to the trunk baseline, in whole seconds. Null for trunk branches and unresolvable repos.

issue.description: Linked GitHub issue number, or null.

pr.description: Linked GitHub PR number, or null.

agents.description: EXPERIMENTAL (issue #408) — agent sessions matched to this worktree from on-disk artefacts (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Mistral Vibe). Additive field: omitted entirely when no session matched, never null. Being experimental-tier, its shape may still change in a minor release; see README.md for the tier rules.

unknown.description: Status couldn't be computed (detached HEAD, unborn branch).

top.description: The most recently active session — what compact surfaces display.

sessions.description: Every matched session, most recent first.

agent_session.description: One detected agent session (issue #408, experimental tier).

freshness.description: Activity classification from artefact recency (active = last 300 s; a terminated Vibe session is always idle).

last_activity.description: Last artefact activity, epoch seconds UTC.
